name: hermes-creator-forge
description: Create, review, and package reusable Hermes Agent skills from workflows and source material.

interface.longDescription: Turn a workflow, source material, or a rough idea into a reusable Hermes Agent skill. Forge the instructions around a real user job, review unsafe or unsupported steps, and validate the finished skill package before delivery. Works in conversation and with local workspace files; no separate service or API key is required.
defaultPrompt: Turn this workflow into a reusable Hermes Agent skill.
Review this SKILL.md for safety, clarity, and Hermes compatibility.
Package this procedure as a Hermes skill with evaluation prompts.
